biggestGap: The hero watermelon silhouette is still a mathematically perfect circle — 108x108 px, aspect 1.000 (round 1 was 99x101, 0.980) — occupying 30.0% of frame height against the plate's 61.1%, so the fruit that anchors the shot is an outline-identical ball at half the reference scale.
evidence: Measured on /home/claude/juice/shots/r2/01-whole-watermelon.png at thresholds 8/16/24/40 the silhouette bbox is 108x108, 107x108, 106x107, 105x103 -> aspect 1.000/0.991/0.991/1.019; height fraction 30.0% of 360 px. Round 1 (shots/r1/01) was 99x101, aspect 0.980, 28.1%. So the headline aspect went from 0.980 to 1.000 (more circular) and scale moved 28.1% -> 30.0%, against a plate-01 watermelon bracketed at x 400-880, y 305-880 = 480x575 in a 1672x941 frame = 61.1% of frame height. src/fruit/geometry.js authors watermelon ry=1.14 (prolate) plus wellTop 0.060 and a stem r=0.072/len=0.21, and src/fruit/species.js line 29 explicitly targets '~107 px across' — the render hits 108 px and the prolate axis and stem never appear in the outline (radial boundary trace: mean r 53.90, std 2.53, std/mean 0.047; the one 18.3% protrusion is a rim-light lobe at upper-left, not a stem — confirmed on a 3.2x brightness-boosted crop). Appendages: the pineapple crown DID appear and is real geometry (12-idle-blade: 205x139 bbox, 38.6% frame height, 6638 crown px spanning ~90 deg of arc off the body) but the blades are fat blunt-tipped tubes that read as a hand of bananas / sea urchin, and in 09-combo+50ms the crown fans radially in every direction with no readable body-plus-top structure — plate-01's pineapple is an elongated barrel with flat pointed needle leaves off one pole only. The strawberry did gain a conical taper with seed pits (09/11 crops) and is the one fruit identifiable by outline. The apple gained nothing visible: measured 90x70 and 72x75 bboxes in 09 and 11, and across three appearances (09, 10, 11) the 0.46-long stem authored in geometry.js never shows — it is a bare green sphere with no stem, no well, no five-lobe waist. The orange is a bare 82x66 circle with no navel. By outline alone, watermelon, apple and orange are the same object.
fix: In src/play/director.js (line 81, radius: sp.radius * 1.06) and the camera setup it feeds, roughly double the hero framing so a whole watermelon subtends >=200 px of a 360 px frame (>=55%, matching plate-01's 61%), and simultaneously bias the spawn orientation in the same file so the authored prolate axis and stem in src/fruit/geometry.js face across the camera rather than down it — at 108 px the 1.9 px stem and the 1.14 prolate are both below the threshold of visibility, which is why authored appendage geometry is measuring as a 1.000-aspect circle.
